acceptance.pk_sec43_staggered_job1: Abaqus 2023 single-rank serial solve completes Stage B Job-1 staggered operator-split phase-field fracture simulation on 3,923 physical elements (11,769 layered elements) to u_y approx 1.5 mm, producing donor ODB for native MISESERI evaluation against Fig. 15b.

hypothesis: Molnar & Gravouil (2017) staggered operator split (*STATIC, DIRECT) resolves monolithic Newton tangent non-convexity during damage localization, enabling full horizon simulation without cutback exhaustion.
